# Bridgeland Builders

> Bridgeland Builders is a Winnipeg renovation and construction company handling whole-home, kitchen, bathroom, basement and commercial renovations, home extensions and general contracting across Winnipeg and Manitoba. Phone: 431-866-5644. Service area: Winnipeg and surrounding Manitoba.

Bridgeland Builders is a service-area renovation and construction contractor based in Winnipeg, Manitoba,
with over 60 years of combined experience and 100+ completed projects. Quotes are free and written,
and permits and inspections are coordinated with the City of Winnipeg when a project requires them.

## Services
- [Whole home renovations](https://bridgelandbuilders.com/services/whole-home-renovations): Whole home renovations in Winnipeg under one crew and one plan — layout, kitchen, baths, flooring and paint coordinated to a single finish date. Free walkthrough.
- [Kitchen renovations](https://bridgelandbuilders.com/services/kitchen-renovations): Kitchen renovations in Winnipeg: better layout, storage, lighting and durable finishes, installed by one crew with a clear written scope. Book a free walkthrough.
- [Bathroom renovations](https://bridgelandbuilders.com/services/bathroom-renovations): Bathroom renovations in Winnipeg with reliable waterproofing, durable tile and practical storage. Clear written quotes and a free in-home walkthrough.
- [Basement renovations](https://bridgelandbuilders.com/services/basement-renovations): Basement renovations in Winnipeg — turn an unfinished or dated basement into warm, dry, usable living space. Framing, insulation, egress and finishing handled.
- [Home extensions](https://bridgelandbuilders.com/services/home-extensions): Home extensions and additions in Winnipeg designed to match the existing house, with permits, structure and finishing coordinated by one contractor.
- [Commercial renovations](https://bridgelandbuilders.com/services/commercial-renovations): Commercial renovations in Winnipeg for retail, offices, restaurants, clinics and hotels — planned around your opening date, operating hours, staff and customers.
